anthropics/fermats-last-theorem.why: A Lean 4 formalization of the Fermat's Last Theorem proof — a proof artefact, not software anyone installs and runs.

PhiloLabs/fable51-worlds.why: A showcase of generated Three.js worlds with walkthrough videos; there is no installable pipeline, only the demo output.

programasweights/compile-by-training.why: The single-script companion artefact to the arXiv paper 2609.04199; the installable product is the separate programasweights package.
